paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Gittin 50a (Hyman cites 56a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.50a.9). They challenged Rava: But did not Avram Hozaah recite, “They do not exact payment, etc.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gittin introduces Avram Choza’ah’s teaching as a baraita, using it to challenge Rava. Hyman gives only the opening.
The supplied Hebrew gives 56a. The linked occurrence is on 50a in the Davidson edition.
